raw_tokens.value: Implement School Focus Power ~ Mind Steed
As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus to conjure a spectral horse. This horse can be either Medium or Large, but it otherwise functions as mount
with a base land speed increased by 20 feet|PREVARGTEQ:OccultistLVL,5

If expend 1 additional point of mental focus, the mount can fly at a speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability, but doing so reduces the mount's duration to %1 minutes.|OccultistLVL|PREVARGTEQ:OccultistLVL,9
